task.title: Clean Your Pulse Bottle
task.shortdesc: Clean your bottle weekly to prevent odours and maintain the seal.

context.p: The bottle base contains electronics and is not dishwasher safe. Only the lid and straw can go in the dishwasher.

step.cmd: Remove the lid and straw from the bottle base.
Hand-wash the bottle base with warm water and a small amount of mild dish soap.
Place the lid and straw on the top rack of the dishwasher, or hand-wash them separately.
Allow all parts to air-dry completely before reassembling.

taskbody.result: Your bottle is clean and ready for use.
